season.evidence: Stored Jun-Oct with winter/spring snowshoe and ski ascents Dec-Apr. Web search (Mountaineers snow and winter scramble trips incl. an April 2026 one, summitpost logs) confirms it is mostly done on snow; histogram is heavily Dec-May. No source states a summer window explicitly.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Apr 26 track continues to a second summit north (about 47.7667,-121.1077) after Sky: a link-up.
Oct 7: the track also visits the northern neighbour summit; link-up, so no assignment.
Feb South Ridge track also goes on to the neighbour summit.
Mar 2013, only 2.3 mi, starts 1.6 km from the trailhead pin (not a complete round trip).

facts.text: In April the north-facing slopes crossed between the Heather Ridge saddle and Sky are avalanche-prone; check danger first
In April the boulder garden past the lake holds soft snow that is easy to posthole; some parties drop north to avoid it
Snowshoes up to the summit ridge, ice axe (April); crampons not needed in early April

notes: All harvested tracks except 306891 combine Sky with the neighbouring summit to the north (about 47.7667,-121.1077), so none was assigned. 306891 is a partial track.
